arguments.prompt:
Create an additive four-angle rig-reference sheet for EXACTLY the HAVENLINE SURVIVOR MALE 01 shown in image1. Preserve their exact face, hairstyle, proportions, outfit, accessories and colors. Identity lock: Adult man with warm tan skin, large brown eyes, tousled dark-brown hair and short neat beard/stubble. Blue winter parka with orange oval upper-arm patches, orange knitted scarf, cream shearling collar/cuffs, blue slanted front pockets and dark central zipper. Navy reinforced-knee trousers, brown winter boots with cream tops. Brown single-flap satchel is on his ANATOMICAL LEFT HIP (viewer RIGHT in FRONT, viewer LEFT in REAR). Its strap crosses from his ANATOMICAL RIGHT SHOULDER down to LEFT HIP, stays attached and changes visible side correctly through views. No backpack. Image2 gives only the shared newly authored brown FIVE-FINGER GLOVE construction, including distinct PALM padding versus BACK finger seams; do not copy that other person's blue sleeve when it differs from image1.

One consistent neutral T-pose across four large panels in a2by2 studio sheet. Upper left FRONT; upper right LEFT; lower left REAR; lower right RIGHT. Straight cardinal elevations, true opposing side profiles, same complete uncropped full body and scale in every panel. Arms extend horizontally at shoulder level, elbows straight, wrists neutral, knees straight, feet separated, soles flat. FRONT shows both PALMS facing camera; REAR shows both BACKS of hands facing camera, with neat finger-back seams and NO oval palm pad. Profile arms are naturally foreshortened, without duplicate limbs or a different wrist pose.

Gloves must have exactly FOUR fingers and ONE short opposed thumb, FIVE digits total, naturally separated with clear background gaps; fingers spread comfortably, middle longest and little shortest. Both hands clearly readable in FRONT and REAR. Make the individual digits proportional and chunky enough for the chibi body; no mittens, fists, fused fingers, six fingers or fingers hidden inside cuffs. Use blue parka sleeves with an orange upper-arm patch and cream fluffy shearling wrist cuffs matching image1. Clear gaps between hands and neighboring panels.

Pale warm gray background, soft neutral studio light, premium sculpted Havenline winter materials and clear silhouette. Header HAVENLINE | SURVIVOR MALE 01 | RIG POSE; only four simple panel labels, no angles or extra explanatory text. No redesign, weapons, scenery or new gear.
CRITICAL profile continuity: keep palms facing the character's FRONT in world space. In LEFT and RIGHT profiles the camera looks ALONG the outstretched arm, so show a narrow edge/end-on glove and foreshortened fingertips, thumb upward. Never turn the palm broadside toward the side camera or bend fingers down. REAR gloves show dorsal seams with no oval palm pads.

reason: Preserve established NPC/survivor identity; add four clear neutral T-pose cardinals with five spread glove digits.
